text: Children and his family. And Ben said, really? Like, I didn't know that. I said, well, here's
something. Here's what I want you to know. I would be proud of you as a man if you would
be willing to die to protect your sister because that's what men do. Could you name five things
came down to, it would either be this, my integrity, my character, my good name, my
family, my country, my God, whatever those things would be, that I would give my
life, because if we don't have those...
